name: ScriptC
tagline: Compile plain TypeScript to native executables with zero runtime
description: ScriptC is a TypeScript-to-native compiler from Vercel Labs, licensed Apache-2.0. It compiles plain TypeScript into a native executable with no Node, V8, or JS engine dependency, achieving ~2ms startup and a 170–200KB binary. Its 99% static compilation is validated by differential testing against Node across 800+ byte-for-byte tests. A --dynamic mode pulls in npm dependencies at runtime, and FFI support exposes the C ABI for interop.
highlights: Compiles plain TypeScript to native executables with no JS engine
99% static compilation verified by 800+ byte-for-byte tests vs Node
--dynamic mode for runtime npm dependency resolution
FFI for calling the C ABI
curatorNote: A promising direction for shipping TypeScript as tiny, fast native binaries — the differential-testing discipline against Node is exactly the confidence tooling this needs.
